notes: The source page is 'General Education Requirements: Option I' (Citrus College's local associate-degree GE pattern), not the Cal-GETC pattern. The Cal-GETC pattern is a separate page linked in the navigation as 'General Education Requirements for Transfer to CSU or UC (Cal-GETC): Option II', and its text is not supplied. No blocks are recorded because the section for this award is not in the text.

Option I prints areas A1/A2 (total minimum 6 semester units), A3, B, C and D (each a minimum of 3 semester units), with Areas E and F listed under 'On This Page'. Many of its courses overlap the closed list, but its unit rules differ from Cal-GETC, so they were not used.
The supplied text is cut off partway through Area D1 (at 'HIST 103H History of W'). Areas E and F are not included.
No program learning outcomes, total units or careers appear in the supplied text. A reviewer should fetch the Option II (Cal-GETC) page to record this certificate.
